wizard_step_discovery_subtitle: We need to find supported single-board computers (Raspberry Pi, Orange Pi, ODROID, Radxa, or Pine64) on your network to begin.
wizard_method_auto_desc: Scans your current local subnet automatically.
wizard_method_manual_desc: Use this if you are on a different VLAN or VPN.
wizard_method_direct_desc: Target a specific host or local MAC address directly, bypassing standard discovery.
wizard_method_tailscale_desc: Automatically discover online nodes across your Tailscale / Headscale overlay network.
wizard_method_proxmox_lxc_desc: Provision a brand new LXC container on your Proxmox VE server automatically.
wizard_method_proxmox_vm_desc: Clone and provision a brand new QEMU VM from a Proxmox template.
wizard_method_proxmox_existing_desc: Deploy to an existing VM or LXC container on your Proxmox server.
wizard_footer_select_method: Select a scanning method to find NjordDeploy devices on your network.
wizard_ssh_tip_body: For passwordless deployment or servers with password login disabled, authorize your public SSH key on the target node using:
dossier_doc_info: This document contains URLs, recommended usernames, and initial setup keys for the services just installed. You can print this dossier (Ctrl+P) or save as PDF for your records.
dossier_security_tip_1: Change initial passwords and setup keys immediately upon first sign-in.
dossier_security_tip_2: Store any two-factor recovery codes in a secure password manager.
dossier_security_tip_3: For services requiring a first-run setup wizard, complete configuration via the provided browser URL.
onboard_modal_subtitle: Configure your container orchestration engine and component template repository source.
welcome_subtitle: Sovereign, agentless container deployment on Debian and Raspberry Pi.
wizard_footer_credentials: Enter the SSH credentials for the devices you want to manage.
wizard_footer_select_software: Choose software to install. Selections in a category are mutually exclusive.
wizard_footer_configure_services: Provide the required values for your selected software.
wizard_footer_confirmation: Please review your selections before generating files and deploying.
wizard_footer_deployment_errors: Deployment completed, but some steps failed.
